newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch economists split on December output.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch economists split on December output.

text.p: Dutch December manufacturing output will show either a slight rise or a slight fall, according to a Reuter poll of bank economists.
Contributing economists were more or less evenly divided between those who saw higher output and those who saw a drop.

Generale Bank, which sees a one percent decline both on an annual and on a monthly basis, said the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) had already indicated that the December figures would be negatively affected by longer than usual factory closures over the Christmas holiday period.
Forecasts contributed by: ABN AMRO, Generale Bank, ING, MeesPierson, J.P. Morgan, NIBStrating, Rabobank. (One outlying forecast was excluded from the range and consensus.)
